description: Clauses with a repeated literal ((x or x), 17/200 easy random formulas) crashed all solvers: Evaluate counted duplicate unassigned occurrences so the clause was never unit, and Analyze_Conflict never reached one current-level literal (Constraint_Error, Resolve_Lit = 0)

Solve_With_Clause_Deletion deleted learned clause Original_Count+1 even when it was a reason, and shifted all later reason indices: crashes on 11/78 UNSAT formulas and wrong answers/crashes on 8/124 SAT and 8/12 planted-SAT formulas (planted SAT reported UNSAT or Constraint_Error)
Is_Satisfiable_DP_Resolution kept every duplicate resolvent: memory exhausted (process killed) on a 9-variable, 47-clause random 3-SAT formula

Is_Satisfiable_DP_Resolution resolved tautological input clauses: (V or not V or A) with (not V) gave the unsound resolvent (A); wrong UNSAT on 16/300 small random formulas (masked by the memory blow-up until that was fixed)

Null-argument checks on the Make_* constructors were preconditions only: in the uniform build (no -gnata, both GNAT 12 and 14) Make_Not (null) / Make_Function ('f', null) were accepted, tests 13.1/13.2 failed and the final pragma Assert did not fire (exit 0); PROOFS.csv recorded this as a GNAT 12 failure. Now not null subtypes; tests.adb also dropped pragma Warnings (Off)

Insert_WME right-activated parent joins before child joins after adding the fact to each alpha memory: when one alpha node feeds two joins of a chain (alpha sharing), the token [F, F] was created twice (once by the parent's left activation, once by the child's right activation); 336 mismatches of beta memory / activation counts against naive tuple enumeration (e.g. 12 tokens vs 9)
Evolve_Preemptive clamped its target Base + Threshold at Fitness_Value'Last: a candidate at 10_000 was accepted over a base of 9_990 for threshold 50 (gain 10). Now an unreachable target returns Base

Substitute_Formula (public) did not avoid capture: (Exists y. G (x, y))[x := y] became Exists y. G (y, y); the substitution lemma failed on random formulas with variable replacements. Now renames the bound variable
